thread:
Ravi: Office potluck idea: bring a dish that represents an LLM persona. short descriptions only.
Hannah: love it. i'm bringing something spicy.
Leo: rules: 1) dish + model name, 2) one-sentence persona, 3) bonus: what prompt they'd ask for seconds.
Ravi: i'll start: "Chili-Chat-2B" - a compact spicy chili that answers 'What's a cozy dinner idea?' with too many emojis. prompt: 'comfort food please'.
Hannah: "Umami-175B" - lavish mushrooms, very verbose, will explain the provenance of every ingredient. prompt: 'tell me the story of this mushroom'.
Sam: "Sampler-7B" - little sliders, indecisive, offers five variations and asks a follow-up. prompt: 'what do you want on it?'.
Leo: "Dry-Humor-XL" - salt-and-vinegar crisps that deliver a one-liner with every crunch. prompt: 'tell me a pun about snacks'.
kitchen-bot: Note: allergen flags set. Please label nuts and gluten.
Ravi: haha imagine the label: "Umami-175B may wax poetic; consume responsibly."
Hannah: also: someone bring napkins, the Chili-Chat-2B cries tears.
Sam: vote with emoji for which model-dish you most want to try.
Leo: :one: for Chili-Chat-2B. spice at lunch is yes.
Hannah: :two: for Umami-175B (curious about stories).
Ravi: :three: for Sam's sliders. can't resist tiny things.
Sam: tally so far 1(1),2(1),3(1). super balanced.
Leo: bonus awards: Best Prompt = Umami-175B, Most Likely to Autocomplete = Sam's sliders.
Hannah: also mandatory sign: "Do not feed to production models."
kitchen-bot: Potluck scheduled: Friday 12:30 PT in the kitchen. Labels and utensils provided.
Ravi: bring a tiny card with your model prompt idea. we'll display them next to dishes.
Leo: agree. this is the nerdiest potluck and i'm proud.
Sam: can't wait. thread closed, bring appetite :plate_with_cutlery:
